scope: PDF build, text, metadata and visual layout only; not a mathematical proof audit.

visual_review.method: All pages inspected in rendered contact sheets; equation-dense and numerical pages additionally inspected at 150 dpi.
visual_review.findings: No visible clipping, overlapping equations, broken glyphs or unreadable table entries. Final edits add Unicode mappings without changing page layout.
visual_review.review_scope: Visual and textual presentation, not independent mathematical verification.
